output.patientMessage: Please arrange an in-person mental health assessment today — through your maternity/postpartum service, a crisis line, or an emergency department — and ask someone you trust to stay with you and the baby in the meantime. If you feel unable to keep yourself or the baby safe, or you start seeing or hearing things others don't, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room right away.
